P.name: Ravenous Flock
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} Enemy champions that {{tip|death|die}} will leave behind a {{as|Soul Fragment|buzzword3}} for 16 seconds. '''Swain's''' ravens will collect nearby dropped {{as|Soul Fragments|buzzword3}}, as well as rip the {{as|Soul Fragments|buzzword3}} out of champions hit by ''{{ai|Vision of Empire|Swain}}'' or ''{{ai|Nevermove 2|Swain|Nevermove's}}'' recast. Once a raven has collected a {{as|Soul Fragment|buzzword3}}, it will fly towards '''Swain''' to grant it to him, while also granting {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings during the travel.

{{sbc|Soul Fragment:}} For each stack, '''Swain''' gains {{as|15 '''bonus''' health}} permanently. Upon claiming a fragment, he will {{tip|heal}} for {{as|6% of his '''maximum''' health}}.

Q.name: Death's Hand
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Swain''' unleashes five bolts of eldritch power over {{rutngt|0.25}} in a cone in the target direction that deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit. Subsequent bolts against an enemy deal 25% '''bonus''' damage.
Q.description2: '''''Swain''' {{tip|sight|reveals}} himself during the cast if there is an enemy champion nearby''.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 180}} {{as|(+ 45% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Damage Per Bolt|{{ap|60*0.25 to 180*0.25}} {{as|(+ {{ap|45*0.25}}% AP)}}|Total Damage|{{ap|60*2 to 180*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|45*2}}% AP)}}}}

W.name: Vision of Empire
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Swain''' summons a demonic eye at the target location that grants {{tip|sight}} of the area for 2 seconds and explodes after {{fd|1.5}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within, halved against {{tip|minions}}, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 50% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
W.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 210}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}|Minion Damage|{{ap|70/2 to 210/2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60/2}}% AP)}}}}
W.description2: Enemy {{tip|champions}} hit are also {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} for 6 seconds and have a {{as|Soul Fragment|buzzword3}} collected from them.

E.name: Nevermove
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Swain''' launches a demonic wave in the target direction.
E.description2: At maximum range, the wave homes back to '''Swain''' and detonates upon the first enemy hit, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|root|rooting}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}. ''Nevermove'' can be recast while {{tip|champions}} hit are rooted.
E.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Swain''' {{tip|airborne|pulls}} the rooted champions over 290 units and collects a {{as|Soul Fragment|buzzword3}} from each of them, {{tip|sight|revealing}} himself for {{tt|{{fd|5 seconds}}|approximate}}. If the targets would be pulled past '''Swain''', they rebound off of him instead, {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}} the excess distance.

R.name: Demonic Ascension
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Swain''' frees the demon within himself, gaining ''Demonic Ascension'' and generating {{as|50 Demonic Energy|azakana}}. ''Demonic Ascension'' is maintained with {{as|Demonic Energy|azakana}}, which decays by {{as|5|azakana}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds, increased to {{as|{{fd|7.5}}|azakana}} after 5 seconds have elapsed. ''Demonic Ascension'' is lost once all {{as|Demonic Energy|azakana}} is depleted to {{as|0|azakana}}. '''Swain''' generates {{as|10 Demonic Energy|azakana}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds while draining from at least one enemy {{tip|champion}}, and fully restores it to the maximum of {{as|50|azakana}} upon scoring a {{tip|champion}} {{tip|takedown}}.
R.description2: {{sbc|Demonic Ascension:}} '''Swain''' is {{tip|ghosted}} and drains the lifeforce of nearby enemies, both dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|healing}} himself every {{fd|0.5}} seconds per target affected. The heal is reduced by 90% against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.
R.leveling2:
{{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|15/2 to 35/2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4/2}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Heal per Tick|{{ap|15/2 to 45/2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5/2}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|1.5/2}}% of his '''bonus''' health)}}|Reduced Heal per Tick|{{ap|15*0.5*0.1 to 45*0.5*0.1}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*0.5*0.1}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|1.5*0.5*0.1}}% of his '''bonus''' health)}}}}
R.description3: After 2 seconds, '''Swain''' gains the ability to cast ''{{ai|Demonflare|Swain}}'', up to 100 times, and does so automatically when ''Demonic Ascension'' expires if ''{{ai|Demonflare|Swain}}'' is not on cooldown at the time of expiration.
R.description4: ''The targets do not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be hit by this ability.''
R.description5: '''''Swain''' can move during Demonic Ascension's cast time.''

R.name: Demonflare
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Swain''' releases a nova of soulfire that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slows}} them by 50%, decaying over {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
R.description2: '''''Swain''' can move during Demonflare's cast time.''
